name: elevenlabs
description: Voice and audio AI with ElevenLabs: text to speech, transcription, agents, dubbing, and sound effects.

interface.shortDescription: Generate speech, clone voices, transcribe audio, and build voice agents.
interface.longDescription: Connects Caeros to the official ElevenLabs MCP server (uvx elevenlabs-mcp) with your ElevenLabs API key. Generate lifelike speech with current models (eleven_v3, eleven_multilingual_v2, eleven_flash_v2_5), transcribe with Scribe, clone and design voices, isolate audio, and create sound effects. Skills also cover the ElevenLabs Agents platform for real-time conversational voice agents, API key setup, and full audio pipelines (STT, dubbing, music).
defaultPrompt: Narrate this script as an mp3 with a warm, calm voice
Transcribe this recording with speaker labels and timestamps
Help me build a voice agent that answers support questions for my store
